stories.title: Driver accused of trying to murder man on electronic motorbike
stories.summary: Sinem Aktas, 29, denies attempted murder after an incident in Aberdeen in June last year.

stories.title: Man who filmed 'horrific' animal fight videos jailed
stories.summary: Ryan Cringean has been jailed for 18 months and banned from keeping a dog for 10 years at Dumfries Sheriff Court.

stories.title: Waste firm appeals over £51m recycling scheme damages claim
stories.summary: Biffa failed in a previous lawsuit where it sought £51m over lost investments in the deposit return scheme, which was shelved in 2023.

stories.title: Police treating 'targeted' shooting of woman as attempted murder
stories.summary: The 27-year-old, who was shot in Glasgow on Monday night, is in hospital in a critical but stable condition.

stories.title: Major oil and gas firm EnQuest pulls out of the North Sea
stories.summary: EnQuest said its decision followed uncertainty over investment and tax rises in recent years, and will focus its business on south-east Asia.

stories.title: Man accused of planning terror attack during Trump visit
stories.summary: Abhay Devdas Nayak is accused of travelling from Luton to commit an "act of terrorism" against supporters of the US leader.

stories.title: Salmond asked top law officer about pardon for William Wallace
stories.summary: A former Lord Advocate has told MPs he was unsure whether the late first minister's request was serious.

stories.title: Glasgow's Hunterian Art Gallery becomes A-listed protected building
stories.summary: Historic Environment Scotland made the decision after a public consultation was held earlier this year.

stories.title: Couple ordered to cut hedge after claiming it was not a hedge
stories.summary: They insisted the description of the boundary plants was wrong and instead claimed it was a mixture of 17 closely planted trees and shrubs.

stories.title: Turkish yard hands over second CalMac ferry after delays
stories.summary: MV Loch Indaal is the second of four new boats built for Scotland's west coast ferry network.

stories.title: Council gets most representations ever over data centre
stories.summary: Dumfries and Galloway Council has received more than 10,000 representations about the Chapelcross plans.

stories.title: Scottish hacker who stole $11m through text message scheme jailed in US
stories.summary: Tyler Buchanan, from Dundee, was a member of the notorious Scattered Spider group and began hacking when he was a teenager.
